Final for Publication

Type-1 Narrative and Plans
For 6716 S, Bishop Street, Chicago IL

Proposed Zoning: RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 3,115 SF

Proposed Land Use: The applicant is proposing to rehab an existing old 2-story frame residential
building with an existing 2-story rear addition and containing two (2) dwelling units. Pursuant to
CZO Section 17-13-1103-A, the applicant is seeking a variation to reduce the total side setback
combination from 5 feet to 2.65 feet and the south side setback from 2 feet to zero.

A, Project’s floor area ratio: 1.22 FAR.
B. Project’s density: 1,557.5 SF 2 proposed dwelling units.
C. Proposed off-street parking: zero parking spaces.

D. Setbacks:
Front setback — Existing to remain
South setback: — None
North setback — 2.65 feet

Rear setback — 33 feet
E. Building height: 28 feet existing to remain

17-13-0303-D Optional variation to reduce the south side setback and the total side setbacks
from 5’ to 2.65’ pursuant to section 17-13-1103-A.
